verdict.rationale: New Relic documents NerdGraph, a GraphQL API for querying New Relic data, and NRQL for querying telemetry for troubleshooting. It also ships an official MCP server that connects external AI tools to the platform and converts plain-English questions into NRQL, with log data covering events, errors, and traces. Together these give an external agent documented programmatic access to metrics, logs, and traces for debugging production. missing for 10: explicit per-signal API documentation showing trace queries through NerdGraph or MCP, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probe found 404s), and independent hands-on corroboration of an external agent debugging production through these APIs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an external agent query metrics, logs, and traces through documented APIs to debug production

citations.quote: NerdGraph is our GraphQL-format API that lets you query New Relic data and configure some New Relic features.
This update provides a standardized, scalable way to connect your favorite AI development tools directly to the rich context of the New Relic platform
Ask questions in plain English, and the MCP server converts them to NRQL to get results—even if you're not a NRQL expert.
Answer a specific question for the purpose of troubleshooting or business analysis

provides deeper visibility into application and infrastructure performance data (events, errors, traces, and more) to reduce mean time to resolution (MTTR) and quickly troubleshoot production incidents
